paragraphs.source_en: Tokugawa Hidetada, Honda Masazumi, Doi Toshikatsu, Sūden, Bonshun, Tenkai, and the others all gathered at Ieyasu's sickbed.

units.source_en: Tokugawa Hidetada, Honda Masazumi, Doi Toshikatsu, Sūden, Bonshun, Tenkai, and the others all gathered at Ieyasu's sickbed.
units.source_zh: 德川秀忠、本多正纯、土井利胜、崇传、梵舜与天海诸人，齐齐到了家康病榻之前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 德川秀忠、本多正纯、土井利胜、崇传、梵舜与天海诸人，齐齐到了家康病榻之前。

paragraphs.source_en: His three sons Yoshinao, Yorinobu, and Yorifusa did not come; Naruse Masanari, Andō Naotsugu, and Nakayama Nobuyoshi attended in their respective places. This was Shogun Hidetada's order. He did not want his young brothers to witness their father's suffering at the hour of death.

units.source_en: His three sons Yoshinao, Yorinobu, and Yorifusa did not come; Naruse Masanari, Andō Naotsugu, and Nakayama Nobuyoshi attended in their respective places.
units.source_zh: 义直、赖宣、赖房三子不曾到来，分别由成濑正成、安藤直次、中山信吉代替他们来此。

units.source_en: This was Shogun Hidetada's order.
units.source_zh: 此乃将军秀忠的吩咐。

units.source_en: He did not want his young brothers to witness their father's suffering at the hour of death.

ja.t: せたくなかったのである。

units.source_zh: 他不想让年幼的兄弟们看到父亲临终时的痛苦。

paragraphs.source_zh: 义直、赖宣、赖房三子不曾到来，分别由成濑正成、安藤直次、中山信吉代替他们来此。此乃将军秀忠的吩咐。他不想让年幼的兄弟们看到父亲临终时的痛苦。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada felt both unease and fear: if his father, a man like a towering mountain crag, should lose command of himself at the end, the sight would surely cast a lasting shadow over his brothers' hearts. Hidetada told them that he would send for them when their father was at the point of death, and that until then they should rest quietly in the western compound.

units.source_en: Hidetada felt both unease and fear: if his father, a man like a towering mountain crag, should lose command of himself at the end, the sight would surely cast a lasting shadow over his brothers' hearts.
units.source_zh: 秀忠有不安，也有恐惧，有如高山巨石的父亲，万一在临终时失去心志，定会给兄弟们心中留下阴影。

units.source_en: Hidetada told them that he would send for them when their father was at the point of death, and that until then they should rest quietly in the western compound.
units.source_zh: 秀忠告诉他们，他会在父亲临终时派人传请，在此之前，且在西苑好生歇息。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀忠有不安，也有恐惧，有如高山巨石的父亲，万一在临终时失去心志，定会给兄弟们心中留下阴影。秀忠告诉他们，他会在父亲临终时派人传请，在此之前，且在西苑好生歇息。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu opened his eyes twice and asked for water.

units.source_en: Ieyasu opened his eyes twice and asked for water.
units.source_zh: 家康曾两次睁开眼睛，要了水。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康曾两次睁开眼睛，要了水。

paragraphs.source_en: But by the following day, he no longer wanted even water. Now and then his eyes would suddenly open, and he would look around in surprise before falling asleep again.

units.source_en: But by the following day, he no longer wanted even water. Now and then his eyes would suddenly open, and he would look around in surprise before falling asleep again.
units.source_zh: 但第二日，他已经连水都不要了，偶尔会突然睁开眼，惊讶地看看四周，接着又睡去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但第二日，他已经连水都不要了，偶尔会突然睁开眼，惊讶地看看四周，接着又睡去。

paragraphs.source_en: After that, Hidetada's heart somehow grew much lighter. He said to Lady Chaa, “I am here. You should go and rest awhile. Kazusa-no-suke… I hear that last night at Rinzai-ji he played the flute Katsutaka had passed on to him.”

units.source_en: After that, Hidetada's heart somehow grew much lighter.
units.source_zh: 此后，秀忠的心竟变得轻松了许多。

units.source_en: He said to Lady Chaa, “I am here. You should go and rest awhile.
units.source_zh: 他对茶阿局道：“这里有我，您去歇息一下。

units.source_en: Kazusa-no-suke… I hear that last night at Rinzai-ji he played the flute Katsutaka had passed on to him.”
units.source_zh: 上总介……听说昨夜在临济寺，吹起了胜隆转交给他的笛子。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 此后，秀忠的心竟变得轻松了许多。他对茶阿局道：“这里有我，您去歇息一下。上总介……听说昨夜在临济寺，吹起了胜隆转交给他的笛子。”

paragraphs.source_en: Lady Chaa's eyes widened in astonishment. She had kept vigil beside Ieyasu with Hidetada throughout the previous night and had seen no one bring him such a report. This too was a lie of Hidetada's, but she failed to detect the flaw.

units.source_en: Lady Chaa's eyes widened in astonishment.
units.source_zh: 茶阿局惊讶地瞪大了眼。

units.source_en: She had kept vigil beside Ieyasu with Hidetada throughout the previous night and had seen no one bring him such a report.

ja.t: ていなかったからである。

units.source_zh: 因为昨夜通宵，她与秀忠同守于家康跟前，并未见人向秀忠禀报。

units.source_en: This too was a lie of Hidetada's, but she failed to detect the flaw.
units.source_zh: 这亦是秀忠的谎言，只是她不曾识到破绽。

paragraphs.source_zh: 茶阿局惊讶地瞪大了眼。因为昨夜通宵，她与秀忠同守于家康跟前，并未见人向秀忠禀报。这亦是秀忠的谎言，只是她不曾识到破绽。

paragraphs.source_en: “Only after you told me about the flute did I understand Father's intention. Father wants him to lay down his sword and follow the path of cultivated elegance. It is a new road through life.”

units.source_en: “Only after you told me about the flute did I understand Father's intention.
units.source_zh: “您告诉了我笛子的事，我才明白了父亲的心思。

units.source_en: Father wants him to lay down his sword and follow the path of cultivated elegance. It is a new road through life.”

ja.t: ませようとなさったのです。それは

units.source_zh: 父亲是想让他放下武刀，走风雅之道，此乃一条新的人生之路。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “您告诉了我笛子的事，我才明白了父亲的心思。父亲是想让他放下武刀，走风雅之道，此乃一条新的人生之路。”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord Shogun… what are you saying?”

units.source_en: “My lord Shogun… what are you saying?”
units.source_zh: “将军……将军说什么？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “将军……将军说什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I had feared that Father would order Tadateru to commit seppuku, but now there is the flute. We owe it to the flute.”

units.source_en: “I had feared that Father would order Tadateru to commit seppuku, but now there is the flute.
units.source_zh: “我原本担心父亲会令忠辉切腹，如今有了笛子。

units.source_en: We owe it to the flute.”
units.source_zh: 多亏了笛子。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我原本担心父亲会令忠辉切腹，如今有了笛子。多亏了笛子。”

paragraphs.source_en: From the afternoon of the fifteenth, Hidetada seemed a changed man and began issuing crisp, decisive orders. He ordered Chaya to return to Kyoto, settled in his mind how Tadateru was to be dealt with, and then summoned Jinryūin Bonshun to question him about “the two principles of Shinto and Buddhism.”

units.source_en: From the afternoon of the fifteenth, Hidetada seemed a changed man and began issuing crisp, decisive orders.

ja.t: わったように、てきぱきと

units.source_zh: 从十五日下午开始，秀忠有如变了一人，开始干脆利落下达指令。

units.source_en: He ordered Chaya to return to Kyoto, settled in his mind how Tadateru was to be dealt with, and then summoned Jinryūin Bonshun to question him about “the two principles of Shinto and Buddhism.”
units.source_zh: 他令茶屋返回京城，对忠辉的处置也已心中有数，随后叫来神龙院梵舜，询问他关于“神道佛法两义”之事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从十五日下午开始，秀忠有如变了一人，开始干脆利落下达指令。他令茶屋返回京城，对忠辉的处置也已心中有数，随后叫来神龙院梵舜，询问他关于“神道佛法两义”之事。

paragraphs.source_en: He decided that once his father passed away, his father's spirit tablet would be transferred to Mount Kunō and enshrined there according to Shinto rites.

units.source_en: He decided that once his father passed away, his father's spirit tablet would be transferred to Mount Kunō and enshrined there according to Shinto rites.
units.source_zh: 他决定，一旦父亲归天，便按照神道仪式将父亲的灵位迁到久能山供奉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他决定，一旦父亲归天，便按照神道仪式将父亲的灵位迁到久能山供奉。

paragraphs.source_en: After concluding his deliberations with Jinryūin Bonshun, Hidetada summoned Sakakibara Kiyohisa. Kiyohisa was Yasumasa's nephew. He had entered Ieyasu's service at eighteen and, now aged thirty-three, was one of Ieyasu's close attendants.

units.source_en: After concluding his deliberations with Jinryūin Bonshun, Hidetada summoned Sakakibara Kiyohisa.
units.source_zh: 结束了和神龙院梵舜的商议，秀忠又把神原清久叫了来。

units.source_en: Kiyohisa was Yasumasa's nephew. He had entered Ieyasu's service at eighteen and, now aged thirty-three, was one of Ieyasu's close attendants.
units.source_zh: 清久乃康政之侄，十八岁便追随家康左右，现年三十三，乃是家康近侍。

paragraphs.source_zh: 结束了和神龙院梵舜的商议，秀忠又把神原清久叫了来。清久乃康政之侄，十八岁便追随家康左右，现年三十三，乃是家康近侍。

paragraphs.source_en: His eyes red and swollen, Kiyohisa naturally dared raise no objection. Yet whether he realized that this was a means of preventing a retainer's suicide, divined by Hidetada from Ieyasu's sleeping face, no one could say. Without it, the loyal and upright Kiyohisa would surely take his own life when Ieyasu died.

units.source_en: His eyes red and swollen, Kiyohisa naturally dared raise no objection.
units.source_zh: 眼睛红肿的清久自然不敢有异议。

units.source_en: Yet whether he realized that this was a means of preventing a retainer's suicide, divined by Hidetada from Ieyasu's sleeping face, no one could say.
units.source_zh: 只是，不知他是否发现，这是秀忠从家康睡颜上读到的一种防止殉死之法。

units.source_en: Without it, the loyal and upright Kiyohisa would surely take his own life when Ieyasu died.
units.source_zh: 如不这样做，忠诚正直的清久定在家康归天之时殉死。

paragraphs.source_zh: 眼睛红肿的清久自然不敢有异议。只是，不知他是否发现，这是秀忠从家康睡颜上读到的一种防止殉死之法。如不这样做，忠诚正直的清久定在家康归天之时殉死。

paragraphs.source_en: After Kiyohisa withdrew, Hidetada also designated the treasured Miike sword that was to serve as the sacred object offered to Mount Kunō, saying that this was his father's command.

units.source_en: After Kiyohisa withdrew, Hidetada also designated the treasured Miike sword that was to serve as the sacred object offered to Mount Kunō, saying that this was his father's command.
units.source_zh: 清久退下，秀忠又定下作为神体、献给久能山的“三池宝刀”，称此为父亲的命令。

paragraphs.source_zh: 清久退下，秀忠又定下作为神体、献给久能山的“三池宝刀”，称此为父亲的命令。

paragraphs.source_en: By then Hidetada himself believed that all these commands had been transmitted to him by his father through the intervals of his faint and faltering breath; they truly were his father's wishes, and he was merely putting those wishes into effect.

units.source_en: By then Hidetada himself believed that all these commands had been transmitted to him by his father through the intervals of his faint and faltering breath; they truly were his father's wishes, and he was merely putting those wishes into effect.

ja.t: しているにすぎなかった。

units.source_zh: 此时的秀忠亦相信，这些都是父亲在断断续续的吐纳之间，传给他的吩咐，实是父亲的意愿，自己只不过是将父亲吩咐付诸实施。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时的秀忠亦相信，这些都是父亲在断断续续的吐纳之间，传给他的吩咐，实是父亲的意愿，自己只不过是将父亲吩咐付诸实施。

paragraphs.source_en: On the sixteenth, after consulting Bonshun and Sūden, Hidetada sent Honda Masazumi to the town magistrate, Hikosaka Kyūbei Mitsumasa, to inspect once more whether the master carpenter Nakai Yamato-no-kami Masatsugu had overlooked anything in the construction of the shrine.

units.source_en: On the sixteenth, after consulting Bonshun and Sūden, Hidetada sent Honda Masazumi to the town magistrate, Hikosaka Kyūbei Mitsumasa, to inspect once more whether the master carpenter Nakai Yamato-no-kami Masatsugu had overlooked anything in the construction of the shrine.
units.source_zh: 十六日，秀忠与梵舜、崇传二人商议后，派本多正纯前往町奉行彦坂九兵卫光正处，再次检视大工头中井大和守正次在神殿的筑建中有无疏忽。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十六日，秀忠与梵舜、崇传二人商议后，派本多正纯前往町奉行彦坂九兵卫光正处，再次检视大工头中井大和守正次在神殿的筑建中有无疏忽。

paragraphs.source_en: At the Hour of the Ox on the seventeenth, Hidetada sent his three brothers back to the western compound for the time being.

units.source_en: At the Hour of the Ox on the seventeenth, Hidetada sent his three brothers back to the western compound for the time being.
units.source_zh: 十七日丑时，秀忠令三个兄弟暂时回了西苑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十七日丑时，秀忠令三个兄弟暂时回了西苑。

paragraphs.source_en: Although Hidetada told everyone to rest, five retainers insisted on keeping vigil beside Ieyasu: Honda Masazumi, Itakura Shigemasa, Doi Toshikatsu, Sakakibara Kiyohisa, and Sakai Tadatoshi. They were all utterly exhausted.

units.source_en: Although Hidetada told everyone to rest, five retainers insisted on keeping vigil beside Ieyasu: Honda Masazumi, Itakura Shigemasa, Doi Toshikatsu, Sakakibara Kiyohisa, and Sakai Tadatoshi.
units.source_zh: 虽然秀忠吩咐众人去歇息，但仍有五个家臣坚持守候家康，是为本多正纯、板仓重昌、土井利胜、神原清久和酒井忠利。

units.source_en: They were all utterly exhausted.
units.source_zh: 他们都已筋疲力尽。

paragraphs.source_zh: 虽然秀忠吩咐众人去歇息，但仍有五个家臣坚持守候家康，是为本多正纯、板仓重昌、土井利胜、神原清久和酒井忠利。他们都已筋疲力尽。

paragraphs.source_en: Lady Chaa alone seemed wholly unaware of fatigue. She watched day and night, had rested only four hours during the day, and now meant to sit up through another night. As Hidetada watched Lady Chaa stroking his father's shoulder, an inexpressible sorrow welled within him: she had understood his decision concerning Tadateru and was greatly relieved, yet she still seemed to have something left to say.

units.source_en: Lady Chaa alone seemed wholly unaware of fatigue. She watched day and night, had rested only four hours during the day, and now meant to sit up through another night.
units.source_zh: 唯独茶阿局似完全不知疲倦，日夜守候，她白日仅歇息了两个时辰，此时又欲通宵守候。

units.source_en: As Hidetada watched Lady Chaa stroking his father's shoulder, an inexpressible sorrow welled within him: she had understood his decision concerning Tadateru and was greatly relieved, yet she still seemed to have something left to say.
units.source_zh: 秀忠望着正抚摸父亲肩膀的茶阿局，一种难以言说的悲哀油然而生：忠辉的处置已得到了她的理解，她亦松了口气，放心许多，只是还似有话要说。

paragraphs.source_zh: 唯独茶阿局似完全不知疲倦，日夜守候，她白日仅歇息了两个时辰，此时又欲通宵守候。秀忠望着正抚摸父亲肩膀的茶阿局，一种难以言说的悲哀油然而生：忠辉的处置已得到了她的理解，她亦松了口气，放心许多，只是还似有话要说。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada felt that some lingering concern still prevented his father from setting out in peace, and so that last breath continued to hang faintly suspended. He wanted to understand his father's unspoken words—and not merely understand them, but carry them out.

units.source_en: Hidetada felt that some lingering concern still prevented his father from setting out in peace, and so that last breath continued to hang faintly suspended.
units.source_zh: 秀忠觉父亲似还有什么牵挂，让他无法安心上路，因此，那一口气总是幽幽悬着。

units.source_en: He wanted to understand his father's unspoken words—and not merely understand them, but carry them out.
units.source_zh: 他希望听懂父亲无声之言，不仅要听懂，他亦要践行。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀忠觉父亲似还有什么牵挂，让他无法安心上路，因此，那一口气总是幽幽悬着。他希望听懂父亲无声之言，不仅要听懂，他亦要践行。

paragraphs.source_en: The room was utterly still, and everyone beside the bed had begun to doze. Then Hidetada suddenly glimpsed in Lady Chaa the image of his own mother, Lady Ai.

units.source_en: The room was utterly still, and everyone beside the bed had begun to doze.
units.source_zh: 室内一片寂静，榻前众人都打起了瞌睡。

units.source_en: Then Hidetada suddenly glimpsed in Lady Chaa the image of his own mother, Lady Ai.
units.source_zh: 这时，秀忠突然从茶阿局身上看到了生母阿爱的影子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 室内一片寂静，榻前众人都打起了瞌睡。这时，秀忠突然从茶阿局身上看到了生母阿爱的影子。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada straightened himself and silently took stock: Chaya had been sent back to Kyoto, guards had been placed around Tadateru, Sakakibara Kiyohisa's resolve to follow his lord in death had been successfully thwarted, nothing concerning Mount Kunō had been overlooked, Itakura Katsushige and Matsudaira Tadazane had strengthened the defenses of Kyoto and Osaka, while Sakai Tadayo was managing the affairs of the shogunate in Edo…

units.source_en: Hidetada straightened himself and silently took stock: Chaya had been sent back to Kyoto, guards had been placed around Tadateru, Sakakibara Kiyohisa's resolve to follow his lord in death had been successfully thwarted, nothing concerning Mount Kunō had been overlooked, Itakura Katsushige and Matsudaira Tadazane had strengthened the defenses of Kyoto and Osaka, while Sakai Tadayo was managing the affairs of the shogunate in Edo…
units.source_zh: 秀忠坐正，默默在心里盘算：已令茶屋回了京都，也已派人守住忠辉，并成功阻止了神原清久的殉死之心，久能山诸事已无疏漏，板仓胜重和松平忠实已加强京坂防务，江户则有酒井忠世打理幕府事务……

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes.”

units.source_en: “Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Nothing in this world belongs to any one person. The realm is the realm of all under heaven, not the realm of one man.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Your son has engraved it upon his heart.”
